g.text: - Synchronous Communication : Simple to design but creates tight coupling and brittle dependency

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: chains. It suffers from poor failure isolation (if one node fails, the request fails) and cascading

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: latency (one slow service degrades the entire system).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Asynchronous Communication (e.g., Message Queues / Kafka): The preferred standard for large-

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: scale resilience. It operates via Single Receivers (standard queues where one service processes and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: deletes a message) or Multiple Receivers (pub/sub where a single event independently triggers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: parallel side-effects across analytics, billing, and notification services).

g.text: Fixed Interval: Wait a set time (e.g., 5s) between attempts.

g.text: > 2s -> 4s -> 8s). Prevents DDoS-ing your own servers during an outage.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: split into multiple distinct payment orders if buying from multiple sellers.

g.text: from the buyer's account to the platform's bank account.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: operations within a highly complex ecosystem.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Ledger Service: The absolute financial system of record.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > The ledger keeps a financial record of the payment transaction.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > When a user pays the seller $1, we record it as debit $1 from a user and credit $1 to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: transaction balances perfectly to zero (Debit = Credit) for absolute traceability and error

g.text: uses PSP-provided widgets to tokenize card details on the client side, ensuring the backend

g.text: - Definition: Moving funds from the e-commerce platform's bank account to the individual

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Trigger: Initiated asynchronously only after specific business conditions are met (e.g.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: delivery confirmation, refund window closure, or an automated end-of-month schedule).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Providers: Utilizes specialized Accounts Payable (AP) providers (e.g., Tipalti, Stripe

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Connect) instead of standard consumer PSPs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Complexity: Involves high regulatory friction (tax documentation like W-8/W-9, cross-border

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: foreign exchange (FX), ongoing AML checks, and global routing rules).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: disbursement, tax compliance, and bank-to-bank routing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Wallet Service: Validates that the seller has a sufficient positive balance available for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: What kind of payment system are we building?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: A payment backend for an e-commerce application (similar to Amazon) that handles

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: all money movement when a customer places an order.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: What payment options should be supported?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: While it supports multiple options like PayPal and bank cards in real life, the primary

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: focus for this scenario will be credit card payments.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: Will we handle credit card payment processing ourselves?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: No, the system will integrate with third-party payment processors such as Stripe,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: Will the system store sensitive credit card data?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: No, for security and compliance reasons, credit card numbers are not stored

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: internally. The third-party processors will handle the sensitive data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: Is the application global, and does it support multiple currencies?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: Yes, the application is global, but for the scope of this design, we will assume it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: operates using only a single currency.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: What is the expected transaction volume?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: The system is expected to handle 1 million transactions per day.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Question: Does the system need to support a pay-out flow to pay sellers?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: Yes, the system must support a pay-out flow to disburse funds to sellers every

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Answer: Yes, because the system interacts with various internal (accounting, analytics) and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: external services, it must include a reconciliation process to identify and resolve any data
